topics.title: Erratic Callers & Unsolicited Requests
topics.summary: A confused caller named Crystal repeatedly contacts Harry, becoming increasingly agitated and making bizarre requests including sending a tape and demanding a dress. The conversation devolves into nonsensical ramblings about past experiences like war and pie-throwing while discussing personal anxieties.

topics.title: Howard Stern’s Repeated ‘What Do You Mean?’ Calls
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard Stern repeatedly asks callers to repeat 'What do you mean?' multiple times. He then attempts to engage with a caller claiming to be connected to Mr. Guess Off and later tries to offer this caller a role on his show before ending the call.

topics.title: Persistent Caller and Building Superintendent
topics.summary: A woman repeatedly contacts the hosts, becoming increasingly agitated while attempting to provide an address for a dispute involving Mr. Kiffel, the building superintendent. She accuses multiple individuals of misdirecting her information and expresses frustration with Howard Stern’s presence.”} id: 1234567890

topics.title: Host Phone Call Mishap
topics.summary: During a phone conversation, a caller makes hostile demands regarding tapes and business agreements with Mr. Kisto. The discussion then abruptly shifts into a bizarre commentary about adopting Chinese orphans, contrasting it with negative perceptions of Western-adopted children, culminating in an uncomfortable comparison to sweatshop labor.

topics.title: Giffords and Wu – Adoption Mishaps
topics.summary: Kathie Lee and Howard discuss Frank Gifford’s attempt to adopt a Chinese orphan with special needs, leading into absurd scenarios involving potential career paths for the child and Jackie's impulsive behavior including an incident chasing an intern. The conversation shifts to discussing unsettling subconscious thoughts and actions related to Casey.

topics.title: Bathroom Confessions and Reno Resort
topics.summary: During a radio segment, callers discuss an incident involving Jackie’s inappropriate behavior in public spaces, followed by Max Baer Jr.’s plans for a themed resort in Reno featuring eccentric attractions like Granny's Shotgun Wedding Chapel. The conversation shifts to personal anxieties about nudity and social interactions.
